import json
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import lightgbm as lgb
import os
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

# Paths
TRAIN_PATH = "./input/train/train.json"
TEST_PATH = "./input/test/test.json"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)


def load_json(path):
    with open(path, "r") as f:
        return pd.DataFrame(json.load(f))


print("Loading data...")
train_df = load_json(TRAIN_PATH)
test_df = load_json(TEST_PATH)

print(f"Train shape: {train_df.shape}, Test shape: {test_df.shape}")

# Target
y_train = train_df["requester_received_pizza"].astype(int)

# Define numeric features present in both datasets based on schema analysis
# These are features available at request time, excluding retrieval-time metrics and IDs/text
NUMERIC_FEATURES = [
    "requester_account_age_in_days_at_request",
    "requester_days_since_first_post_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_comments_in_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_posts_on_raop_at_request",
    "requester_number_of_subreddits_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_minus_downvotes_at_request",
    "requester_upvotes_plus_downvotes_at_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request",
    "unix_timestamp_of_request_utc",
]


# Helper to extract numeric data
def get_numeric_data(df, cols):
    df_num = df[cols].copy()
    # Impute missing values with median calculated on train
    medians = df_num.median()
    df_num = df_num.fillna(medians)
    # Fill non-numeric errors if any
    return df_num.values.astype(float)


# Extract numeric features
X_train_num = get_numeric_data(train_df, NUMERIC_FEATURES)
X_test_num = get_numeric_data(test_df, NUMERIC_FEATURES)


# Add temporal features
def add_temporal_features(df):
    df = df.copy()
    ts = pd.to_datetime(df["unix_timestamp_of_request_utc"], unit="s", errors="coerce")
    df["hour_of_day"] = ts.dt.hour.fillna(0).astype(int)
    df["day_of_week"] = ts.dt.dayofweek.fillna(0).astype(int)
    df["month"] = ts.dt.month.fillna(1).astype(int)
    return df[["hour_of_day", "day_of_week", "month"]]


train_temp = add_temporal_features(train_df)
test_temp = add_temporal_features(test_df)

X_train_num = np.hstack([X_train_num, train_temp.values])
X_test_num = np.hstack([X_test_num, test_temp.values])

# Text features
TEXT_FEATURES = ["request_title", "request_text_edit_aware"]


def create_tfidf(text_df):
    # Combine title and body
    text_col = text_df[TEXT_FEATURES].fillna("").agg(" ".join, axis=1)
    tfidf = TfidfVectorizer(max_features=1500, stop_words="english", ngram_range=(1, 2))
    return text_col, tfidf


train_texts, tfidf_vec = create_tfidf(train_df)
test_texts, _ = create_tfidf(test_df)

tfidf_mat_train = tfidf_vec.fit_transform(train_texts)
tfidf_mat_test = tfidf_vec.transform(test_texts)

# Combine numeric and text features
from scipy.sparse import hstack, csr_matrix

X_train_sparse = hstack([csr_matrix(X_train_num), tfidf_mat_train])
X_test_sparse = hstack([csr_matrix(X_test_num), tfidf_mat_test])

print("Features prepared. Training model...")

# Split for validation
X_tr, X_val, y_tr, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train_sparse, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

params = {
    "objective": "binary",
    "metric": "auc",
    "boosting_type": "gbdt",
    "num_leaves": 31,
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "feature_fraction": 0.9,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_freq": 5,
    "verbose": -1,
    "seed": 42,
    "n_estimators": 1000,
}

train_data = lgb.Dataset(X_tr, label=y_tr)
val_data = lgb.Dataset(X_val, label=y_val, reference=train_data)

model = lgb.train(
    params,
    train_data,
    num_boost_round=1000,
    valid_sets=[val_data],
    callbacks=[lgb.early_stopping(50), lgb.log_evaluation(-1)],
)

# Validation Score
val_pred = model.predict(X_val)
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.4f}")

# Test Prediction
test_pred = model.predict(X_test_sparse)

# Submission
sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sampleSubmission.csv")
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {"request_id": sample_sub["request_id"], "requester_received_pizza": test_pred}
)
submission.to_csv(f"{SUBMISSION_DIR}/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved successfully.")
